name: Dampened Shatterbow

effects.name: Dampened
effects.tooltip: Dampened : This item has been in a wet environment for too long and its original power has been weakened. Combine it with a Token of Vulkoor at the Altar of Vulkoor in the Red Fens to restore it back to its former glory.

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +1 Enhancement Bonus : +1 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Screaming
effects.tooltip: Screaming : Screaming weapons emit a piercing screech whenever they are used to make a successful attack. This screech does an additional 1 to 6 sonic damage.

effects.name: Construct Bane
effects.tooltip: Construct Bane : A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Constructs, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +2 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 2 to 12 points of damage against the foe.

effects.name: Move Silently
effects.tooltip: Move Silently -5 : Passive: -5 penalty to the Move Silently skill.

flavor_text: Arrows fired from this bow are invested with powerful sonic energy, and are shot so fast that they shriek through the air. Constructs hit by these arrows are wounded grievously.

source.raw: The Claw of Vulkoor , Scorpions optional chest (don't kill scorpions)
